base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: I2C is a wire-level protocol specification, not a peripheral block guide. There is no architectural register map at the protocol layer. Concrete I2C-controller IP blocks define their own register file (typically: address register, data register, status/interrupt register, control register, baud rate register) at the SoC integration level — covered by individual block guides, not by UM10204.
